name: week-path
label: Week path
description: A vertical path through the week. A line draws itself down the page as you scroll and each step lights up when you reach it.

defaults.heading: From the market stall to your door, in three steps.

content.text: You choose a size. The crew does the shopping. Everything else is already planned.
The chef starts from what is in season and builds a menu around it. You pick a basket size, tell us what you never want, or say "surprise me." Baskets close Wednesday at 8pm.

steps.title: A local chef plans the week

content.text: A crew member walks the Boulder Farmers Market with the list and fills every basket at the stalls, straight from the people who grew it.
One planned route carries the baskets out. Each comes with the week's recipes and a label naming every farm it came from.

steps.title: One route brings it to your door

ai.purpose: A scroll-drawn path of 2 to 6 steps that explains how something works over time.
ai.whenToUse: To explain the weekly rhythm right after the opening.
ai.avoid: More than six steps; long paragraphs.
